Childhood Nightmare

View larger artwork (new tab)

  • MediumColored pencil
  • Year2024
  • CategoryDrawing
  • Notes12" x 18", based on dream

Overview

This was another assignment in my SCCC art class, where we were assigned to draw a dream we've had. I always wanted to capture a vivid enigmatic nightmare I had as a child, where I was in the backseat of my parents' car driving away from home, when they suddenly drove into a patch of bushes at the end our block where we drove off a cliff into a vast jungle with an evil purple gorilla who caught us and ate us. My parents did not react the entire time while I freaked out.

Process / Additional Notes

Expressively cartoonish-styled colored pencil drawing on drawing pad, first conceptualized as a graphite pencil drawing to understand the composition and expressive direction.
